_doc: Hungary-relevance model for the Command Air Intelligence Brief. Deterministic and editable. HU relevance is a SEPARATE dimension from air-power significance (1-5, from the analytical layer): a distant item can be HIGH here, a significant item can be LOW. Points add up from geography plus factor matches; the level follows the thresholds. Every applied factor is written into the report with its points and reason, so a score can always be traced. Edit mh_platforms when the MH inventory or plans change.

hun.why: directly concerns Hungary / the Hungarian Defence Forces

aut.why: neighbouring state (non-NATO, EU) — shares Hungary's western airspace boundary

svk.why: neighbouring NATO state — Hungarian Gripens have covered Slovak airspace during its fighter transition; shared regional air policing space

ukr.why: neighbouring state at war — air activity and losses close to Hungary's north-eastern border

rou.why: neighbouring NATO state on the Black Sea flank — its air posture shapes the south-eastern air picture around Hungary

srb.why: neighbouring non-NATO state — changes to its combat air fleet alter the regional air balance on Hungary's southern border

hrv.why: neighbouring NATO state — part of the same regional air policing and training space

svn.why: neighbouring NATO state without its own fighter force — its air policing is provided by allies, Hungary among them

rus.why: principal military threat to NATO's eastern flank — changes to Russian air power drive NATO posture

blr.why: Russian-aligned state bordering NATO's eastern flank and Ukraine

bih.why: non-NATO Western Balkan state in Hungary's near region (EUFOR mission area)

mda.why: non-NATO state between Ukraine and Romania — repeated drone and missile overflight

pol.why: NATO's largest eastern-flank air force build-up — sets the pace for regional allied capability

cze.why: Visegrád partner and fellow Gripen operator

bgr.why: eastern-flank NATO state on the Black Sea — same regional posture as Romania

est.why: Baltic NATO state — part of the air policing mission set Allied air forces rotate through

lva.why: Baltic NATO state — part of the air policing mission set Allied air forces rotate through

deu.why: major European ally and framework nation for eastern-flank air contributions

tur.why: NATO ally controlling the Black Sea straits
